# How-To Guides

Each guide answers one "how do I...?" question and assumes you already know the
relevant concepts. If you are new to RECAP, start with
[Getting Started](../getting-started/01-what-is-recap.qmd) instead; it teaches
the same operations in order, with explanation.

## Set Up Access

Run a RECAP server, or connect to one that already exists.
[Set Up a RECAP Server](setup-recap-server.qmd) covers deployment and
configuration; [Authenticate a Remote Client](use-remote-authentication.qmd)
covers credentials. Neither is needed for local SQLite work.

## Create Templates

Define the shapes your experiment reuses: resource templates, process
templates, nested hierarchies, and how to revise them safely once they are in
use.

## Create and Edit Instances

Record real experimental data against those definitions: process runs, runtime
children, property edits, lifecycle transitions, and safe retries.

## Query Experiments

Find and filter records, control which relationships are loaded, and trace
provenance from a result back to its inputs.

## Operate and Troubleshoot

Diagnose failures using request IDs, and keep queries efficient as data grows.

---

For definitions of terms used throughout these guides, see the
[Glossary](../reference/glossary.qmd). For exact signatures, see the
[API Reference](/reference/index.html).
